landing.heroTitle: Practice tests that feel like the real exam
landing.heroSubtitle: Thousands of CPNS, TOEFL, psychometric and general test questions with timers, full explanations, and score analytics to help you pass.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need in one app
landing.featuresSubtitle: Built mobile-first so you can practice comfortably anywhere.
landing.feature1Description: Organize questions by test type, subtest, topic, and difficulty. Rich text, math formulas, images and audio supported.
landing.feature2Description: Per-subtest timers, autosaved answers, color-coded question numbers, and auto-submit when time runs out.
landing.feature3Description: Per-subtest scores, passing grades, percentile, national ranking, and per-question explanations.
landing.feature4Description: Create a session with a 6-character code, monitor participants live, then export the report.
landing.ctaDescription: Sign up for free, pick a package, and start right away. No credit card needed.
landing.builtWith: Built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS and Zustand.
landing.heroNote: No credit card needed. You can start right after signing up.
landing.previewPrompt: Article 1 paragraph (3) of the 1945 Constitution states that the State of Indonesia is a…
landing.stepsTitle: Three steps and you are done
landing.stepsSubtitle: No complicated flow — pick a package, take the test, read your result.
landing.step1Description: Filter by category, pricing model or keyword. Free packages are ready for you to start.
landing.step2Title: Take it like the real exam
landing.step2Description: Per-subtest timer, autosaved answers, a colour-coded question navigator and an unsure flag.
landing.step3Description: Score per subtest, passing grade, percentile, national rank and a per-question discussion.
landing.typesTitle: Every test type in one app
landing.typesSubtitle: From the CPNS SKD to accuracy tests — the structure follows the real exam.
landing.pricingSubtitle: Start for free. Unlock the discussion only when you need it.
landing.plan1Description: Best for starting your practice at no cost.
landing.plan2Description: Take it first, pay only for the detailed result.
landing.plan3Description: For a full simulation including essays.
landing.faqSubtitle: Still unsure? Here are the short answers.
landing.faq1Answer: Yes. Free packages can be taken at no cost, score and discussion included. Freemium packages are playable for free, then you pay to unlock the detailed result and discussion.
landing.faq2Question: What happens when time runs out?
landing.faq2Answer: Answers are submitted automatically at the end of the last subtest. Every answer is autosaved, so nothing is lost.
landing.faq3Question: Can I take a tryout on my phone?
landing.faq3Answer: Absolutely. The whole interface is mobile-first: large tap targets, one-thumb navigation and a timer that keeps running even if you close the browser.
landing.faq4Answer: Pick a payment method, transfer the exact unique amount, then upload your proof of payment. An admin verifies it and the discussion unlocks automatically.
landing.faq5Answer: This demo keeps every record in your own browser (localStorage) as a simulation. When a real backend is connected, data moves to the server without changing the interface.
landing.footerTagline: Online tryout practice for the CPNS SKD, TOEFL, psychometric tests and general exams.
